name: New Hope Worldwide Social Security
principles: Every person may have a private append-only claim ledger.
AI explains and recommends; it does not sign transfers or deny essential support by itself.
Every transfer requires authenticated human authorization and an immutable audit event.
Products and services must be verified as real, legal, and safe before their coins can be accepted.
Rights-holder allocations are attached to eligible transactions and cannot exceed 100 percent.
People can inspect decisions, correct records, withdraw consent where legally possible, and appeal.
